summary.text: Glen Aldrich is a Republican state representative from Belknap 6 who has represented Belknap 6 since December 2024 and previously represented Belknap 2 from 2014 to 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Glen Aldrich served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Belknap 2 from 2014 to 2022, according to Ballotpedia.
He assumed office representing Belknap 6 on December 4, 2024.
